To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the effects of TBS on cortical excitability are not simply proportional to the stimulation duration.
iTBS and cTBS are not the same, and that iTBS is not the most efficient protocol in terms of number and intensity of impulses.

(a) the duration of TBS protocols cannot be arbitrarily prolonged in order to achieve more effective stimulation, because (b) when stimulating too long the effects are reversed, i.e. the excitatory iTBS becomes inhibitory and the normally inhibitory iTBS becomes excitatory.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the relationship between TBS-induced plastic changes and the length of the stimulation protocol.
the effects of prolonged theta burst stimulation on motor cortex excitabilty.
the question whether the duration of stimulation is a relevant factor in the induction of TMS after-effects and, if so, what is the optimal duration for a given protocol.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the duration of TBS protocols should be optimized to achieve the desired after-effect, rather than being extended to achieve a more pronounced effect.
the optimal TBS duration is not the longest possible.

the most efficient protocol in terms of intensity, duration and number of stimuli is the iTBS, which is facilitatory when applied for a short period of time and inhibitory if the duration of stimulation is prolonged.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
TMS-induced plasticity cannot simply be enhanced by prolonging the stimulation duration, but that there is a sweet spot for the stimulation duration, where the desired after-effects can be achieved.
TBS-induced changes in cortical excitability are not linearly related to stimulation duration.
there is an optimal duration for each TBS protocol.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the optimal TBS duration is likely to be in the vicinity of the conventional protocol duration.
the duration of TBS protocols should be kept as short as possible.
the stimulation duration is an essential parameter in TBS, which needs to be considered carefully.
